_readme: One entry per reel. A reel appears on the site only once "instagram" holds its public link (add it after the reel is live, then run python3 tools/build_reels.py and python3 tools/build_catalogue.py site/data/catalogue.json). "account" is who posts it; "collab" is the co-author. "pages" are programme, guide or news pages (file names without .html) the reel sells or explains: the reel is embedded on each programme page listed here. Series: jaisa-tha (Talaash 3D reconstructions), explorer (archaeologywala, collab), khudai-khabar (archaeologywala only, satire: never list programme pages), news (archaeologywala faceless news reels, collab). Full rules: docs/SOCIAL.md.
